## Overview

DEGinsight turns a differential-expression result into evidence-graded,
ontology-grounded mechanistic hypotheses. The pipeline has four stages:

1. **Enrichment** — `run_ora()` (built-in) or any `clusterProfiler` result.
2. **Prompting** — `build_interpretation_prompt()` grounds the LLM with the
   exact enriched terms, statistics and overlapping genes.
3. **Interpretation** — `interpret_enrichment()` (single model) or
   `interpret_ensemble()` (multi-model majority vote).
4. **Auditing** — `validate_terms()` flags hallucinated pathway names and
   computes the hallucination rate.

## Setup

```{r}
library(DEGinsight)

# Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Examples: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Moonshot,
# local Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1).
Sys.setenv(LLM_API_KEY = "sk-...")
Sys.setenv(LLM_BASE_URL = "https://api.deepseek.com/v1")
```

**Privacy note**: prompts contain pathway names and gene symbols. For
controlled data, use a local backend (e.g. Ollama) — only the endpoint URL
changes.

## Quick start with bundled example data

```{r}
data(example_data)   # example_deg, example_gene_sets, example_ora

# (optional) estimate cost before spending anything
estimate_cost(example_ora, contrast = "TNF-stimulated vs control HeLa cells",
              species = "Homo sapiens",
              models = c("deepseek-chat", "kimi-k2"))

# single-model interpretation
res <- interpret_enrichment(
  example_ora,
  contrast = "TNF-stimulated vs control HeLa cells",
  species  = "Homo sapiens",
  tissue   = "HeLa",
  direction = "up",
  model = "deepseek-chat"
)
res
```

## End-to-end from a DEG table

```{r}
out <- interpret_deg(
  example_deg,
  gene_col = "symbol", padj_col = "padj", logfc_col = "log2FoldChange",
  gene_sets = example_gene_sets,
  contrast = "TNF-stimulated vs control", species = "Homo sapiens",
  models = c("deepseek-chat", "kimi-k2")   # ensemble mode
)
out$interpretation$consensus
```

With real data, load gene sets from a GMT file (e.g. MSigDB Hallmark):

```{r}
gs <- read_gmt("h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt")
out <- interpret_deg(my_deg, gene_col = "symbol", gene_sets = gs,
                     contrast = "...", species = "Homo sapiens")
```

## Using clusterProfiler results

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
ego <- enrichGO(gene = deg_symbols, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP", readable = TRUE)
df <- as.data.frame(ego)
df <- data.frame(pathway = df$Description, p_adjust = df$p.adjust,
                 overlap = df$Count, size = NA, genes = gsub("/", ",", df$geneID))
res <- interpret_enrichment(df, contrast = "...", species = "Homo sapiens",
                            vocabulary = go_vocabulary("BP"))
```

## HTML report

```{r}
render_report(out$ora, out$interpretation,
              output_file = "TNF_interpretation.html")
```

## Reproducibility

- All LLM calls default to `temperature = 0`.
- Responses are cached on disk (see `DEGinsight_cache()`): re-running a
  vignette or benchmark is deterministic and free. Cache keys hash the full
  request, including the model name.
- Record model IDs and dates in publications; frontier models drift.
